title: Armored Figure on Anvil
description: A figure in full metal armor sits on a large cracked anvil with glowing orange lines, arms crossed over its chest. The figure has a glowing purple crystal for a head emitting smoke and a white rose hovers above it inside a large circular metal ring covered in painted marks and runes, all set against a swirling dark purple background with floating objects and green aurora lights at the bottom.
prompt: A figure in full metal armor sits centered on a large cracked black anvil with glowing orange cracks, arms crossed over its chest. The figure has a glowing purple crystal instead of a head with smoke rising from it and a white rose floating above inside a large circular metal ring covered in painted marks and runes. The background is a swirling dark purple vortex with floating objects like books, chains, insects, and lanterns, with green and pink aurora lights glowing at the bottom of the scene.
